flowSteps.name: Prepare unsigned drafts
flowSteps.action: Build payload and covenant spend drafts in standard format

flowSteps.name: Load KasWare in managed browser
flowSteps.action: Launch Chromium, load unpacked KasWare extension, activate in toolbar

flowSteps.name: Sign each unsigned tx
flowSteps.action: For each draft: inject unsigned tx → click sign → extract signature

flowSteps.name: Assemble signed drafts
flowSteps.action: Receive signature bytes, reconstruct full signed tx, write artifact

flowSteps.name: Submit to TN12
flowSteps.action: Use signed drafts with wRPC endpoint to submit and get txid
